caption: The drawing depicts a figurine of a clown performing a handstand on top of a blue spherical object. The clown is dressed in a maroon jacket with yellow buttons, yellow pants, and has black shoes. His face is white with red lips and a blue ruffled collar around his neck. The blue spherical object appears to have a yellow band with a red circular ornament in the center and an arrow-shaped lock or keyhole. The sphere sits atop a round, ornate, golden base with three visible scroll-shaped feet and decorative patterns. The overall composition is centered on a plain off-white background, with the artist's signature "S. Czaganias" written in red at the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Toy Bank
